Name: Geode Preview
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
Shows a simple preview of the treasure in the geode.

A config is provided to:
[list]
[*]Toggle whether or not the preview should show outside of clints geode menu
[*]Toggle the stack number on / off
[/list]
GMCM is supported

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b][/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder

[url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/GeodePreview][Source Code][/url]
